_comment: WORKSHOPS PAGE COPY (English). REPOSITIONING (2026-09-16): Taqathon 2026's hackathon was postponed and this page — file/URL still named 'schedule' to avoid an unnecessary URL change, same reasoning as every other migration in this project — was renamed 'Workshops' and made the primary destination for the new remote-workshop-series direction. 'intro' is adapted from the association's own official description of the series (three interconnected areas, applied/interactive focus). The 3 real workshops below are the exact lineup the user supplied directly (2026-09-16): dates were originally day/month only; the user confirmed the year is 2026 (2026-09-16 follow-up), so it's now included below rather than flagged as missing. Exact start times are still unconfirmed — each workshop's 'time' field is the user's own explicit placeholder text ('To Be Announced' / 'سيُعلن لاحقًا'), not a guess. The remote session platform/link is also still unconfirmed, flagged via workshopsNote instead of guessed. Workshop 3 genuinely has no separate moderator in the source material (3 speakers only) — 'moderator' is null on purpose, not an oversight; schedule.njk skips rendering that row when null. The old hackathon-phase 'keyDates' timeline (registration/screening/mentorship/winners) no longer reflects the current plan and is NOT rendered anymore (see schedule.njk), but is kept below rather than deleted in case a version of it is needed again once the program's next phase is decided.
